overview_nodes.role: composition root and host orchestration
constraints: Construct dependencies explicitly.
Only validated replacement sessions become active.

overview_nodes.role: deterministic GameSession aggregate and public simulation boundary
constraints: Pure RefCounted/value-like simulation boundary.
Every gameplay mutation commits synchronously through GameSession.

overview_nodes.role: typed immutable Realmz package definitions
constraints: Installed package definitions are immutable typed content.

overview_nodes.role: fixed Classic rules, arithmetic, combat, magic, inventory, economy, and time collaborators
constraints: Rules are presentation-independent and use explicit Classic arithmetic.

overview_nodes.role: authoritative map topology, transitions, visibility, and world queries
constraints: MapTopology plus WorldState overlays are the only source of simulation map facts.

overview_nodes.role: mutable typed playthrough state and save aggregate components
constraints: Mutable state is distinct from immutable package definitions.

overview_nodes.role: serializable deterministic randomness and Realmz clock support
constraints: Gameplay draws use the session-owned RealmzRng.

overview_nodes.role: validated Classic program and Safe Scenario Action definitions
constraints: Classic provenance and bounded Safe bytecode remain explicit.

overview_nodes.role: serializable Classic and Safe scenario execution engine
constraints: VM limits and serializable interaction yields are explicit.

overview_nodes.role: single RealmzRuntimeApi and typed Classic/Safe operation adapters
constraints: All VM domain mutations cross one session-owned RealmzRuntimeApi.

overview_nodes.role: untrusted .realmz2 package discovery, validation, and typed construction
constraints: Package validation completes before typed construction.

overview_nodes.role: save, canonical serialization, settings, and external filesystem adapters
constraints: Filesystem access stops at infrastructure.

overview_nodes.role: responsive Classic-wide Godot shell, original-control catalog, scene-backed workspaces, interactions, map, animation, and audio presenters
constraints: Presentation reads detached GameView and never mutates gameplay state.
One responsive map-first visual system preserves Classic workflow, exact control pixels, and player-knowable content without exposing hidden facts.

overview_nodes.role: synchronous ordered SessionStep event and interaction envelope
constraints: A step contains committed events, at most one serializable interaction, revision, and explicit state.

overview_nodes.role: deterministic unit, contract, integration, presentation, and scenario verification suites
constraints: Evidence labels distinguish source, runtime, oracle, and live-route proof.

overview_nodes.role: PowerShell aggregate gate, package probes, route harnesses, and fixture utilities
constraints: Tools resolve repository roots and keep commercial paths external.

overview_nodes.role: immutable synthetic .realmz2 package fixture
constraints: Synthetic fixture data is not commercial campaign content.

overview_nodes.role: user:// save and settings persistence store
constraints: Persistent files use verification and atomic replacement.

overview_nodes.role: external Godot 4.7.1 host and runtime API
constraints: Godot hosts presentation; gameplay remains independent of Nodes and host services.

overview_nodes.role: vendored Godot MCP Pro development service
constraints: Development inspection aid only; release exports exclude addon code.

flows.label: Load a compiled package
flows.outcome: The validated immutable package becomes typed content, a deterministic session starts, and the first detached view is presented.

flows.label: Submit exploration movement
flows.outcome: Topology gates movement, scenario execution may run, state and events commit synchronously, and presentation refreshes from the resulting view.

flows.label: Resolve a yielding encounter and Scenario Action

trigger.label: Resolve a yielding encounter and Scenario Action

flows.outcome: A typed interaction is yielded, the serialized frame resumes through encounter result, reusable Scenario Action, XAP, and CODE 111, then emits ordered events.

flows.label: Save and restore a session
flows.outcome: The session snapshot is verified and atomically persisted, then a package-matched restore replaces the session without exposing partial state.

flows.label: Resolve a combat interaction
flows.outcome: Combat actions enter through the typed interaction contract, rules mutate save-owned combat state, and the completed battle returns through the same session boundary.
